analysis_recipe:
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
import csv,json,os,resource,subprocess,sys,time
import numpy as np
started=time.monotonic()
repo=Path.cwd()
root=repo/"benchmarks/results/copy_branch_ablation_r1_v1_20261013/QfO"
plan_path=root/"execution_plan.json"
plan=json.loads(plan_path.read_text())
source=Path(plan["source_root"])
sys.path.insert(0,str(source))
from benchmark_tools.prepare_ob_candidate_neighborhood import record,check
from benchmark_tools.run_membership_hillclimb import write_json
from benchmark_tools.audit_historical_profile_ablation import read_partition
from orthohmm import refinement
output=repo/"benchmark_tools/results/copy_eligibility_context_20261013.json"
snapshot=repo/"benchmark_tools/results/copy_eligibility_structural_snapshot_20261013.json"
assert not output.exists() and not snapshot.exists()
live=json.loads((root/"results.json").read_text())
assert live["dataset"]=="QfO" and live["job_id"]=="24207" and live["execution_plan"]==record(plan_path)
structural=live["structural_controls"]
assert tuple(structural)==("control","deferred500")
write_json(snapshot,{"status":"immutable_structural_snapshot_not_terminal_score_admission","source_revision":live["source_revision"],"producer_job_id":live["job_id"],"execution_plan":live["execution_plan"],"parent_admission":live["parent_admission"],"structural_controls":structural,"scheduler_at_capture":subprocess.check_output(["scontrol","show","job","24207"],text=True)})
checked=[record(snapshot),record(plan_path),live["parent_admission"],record(repo/"benchmark_tools/hillclimb_copy_eligibility_context_20261013.json")]
parent=json.loads(Path(live["parent_admission"]["path"]).read_text())
assert all(c["status"]=="independent_content_readback_verified" for c in parent["cells"])
for i,label in enumerate(("control","deferred500")):
    row=structural[label]
    for key,parent_key in (("candidate_partition","candidate"),("membership_constraints","constraints")):
        assert row["candidate"][key]["sha256"]==plan["parent_candidates"][i][parent_key]["sha256"]
        checked.extend([row["candidate"][key],plan["parent_candidates"][i][parent_key]])
    checked.extend([row["seed"],row["copy_split_trace"]])
assert structural["control"]["seed"]["sha256"]==plan["data"]["golden_refinement"]["sha256"]
checked.append(plan["data"]["golden_refinement"])
reference_plan_path=repo/"benchmark_tools/results/qfo_reference_stage_plan_v3_20261012.json"
reference_plan=json.loads(reference_plan_path.read_text())
name_record=reference_plan["inputs"]["checkpoint_gene_names.txt"]
species_record=reference_plan["inputs"]["checkpoint_gene_to_species.npy"]
assert Path(name_record["path"]).parent==Path(plan["data"]["checkpoint"])
assert plan["data"]["checkpoint_manifest"]==reference_plan["inputs"]["checkpoint_manifest"]
checked.extend([record(reference_plan_path),name_record,species_record,plan["data"]["checkpoint_manifest"],plan["data"]["partition"]])
names=Path(name_record["path"]).read_text().splitlines()
species=np.load(species_record["path"],mmap_mode="r",allow_pickle=False)
assert len(names)==len(set(names))==len(species)==984137 and len(np.unique(species))==78 and np.issubdtype(species.dtype,np.integer)
index={name:i for i,name in enumerate(names)}
partitions=read_partition(Path(plan["data"]["partition"]["path"]),set(names))
large_members={tuple(sorted(index[g] for g in group)) for group in partitions if len(group)>=70}
events=[json.loads(Path(structural[label]["copy_split_trace"]["path"]).read_text())["events"] for label in ("control","deferred500")]
assert len(events[0])==len(events[1])==470
owners={}
summary=Counter()
for ordinal,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(*events)):
    assert {k:v for k,v in a.items() if k!="deferred"}=={k:v for k,v in b.items() if k!="deferred"}
    members=a["members"]
    assert members==sorted(set(members)) and len(members)==a["size"] and tuple(members) in large_members
    assert all(type(i) is int and 0<=i<len(names) for i in members)
    counts=Counter(int(species[i]) for i in members)
    assert max(counts.values())==a["maximum_species_copies"] and a["dataset_species_count"]==78
    large=refinement._should_split_large_copy_cluster(len(members),counts,78,refinement.DEFAULT_COPY_SPLIT_MIN_SIZE,refinement.DEFAULT_BROAD_COPY_SPLIT_MIN_SPECIES_COUNT,refinement.DEFAULT_COPY_SPLIT_MIN_DATASET_SPECIES)
    medium=refinement._should_split_medium_panel_copy_cluster(len(members),counts,78,refinement.DEFAULT_PANEL_COPY_SPLIT_MIN_SIZE,refinement.DEFAULT_PANEL_COPY_SPLIT_MAX_SIZE,refinement.DEFAULT_PANEL_COPY_SPLIT_MIN_SPECIES_COUNT,refinement.DEFAULT_PANEL_COPY_SPLIT_MIN_DATASET_SPECIES)
    assert type(a["large_copy_eligible"]) is bool and type(a["medium_copy_eligible"]) is bool
    assert (large,medium)==(a["large_copy_eligible"],a["medium_copy_eligible"]) and large!=medium
    assert a["deferred"] is False and b["deferred"]==((large or medium) and len(members)<=500)
    kind="large_over_500" if large and len(members)>500 else "large_at_most_500" if large else "medium_at_most_500"
    summary[kind+"_families"]+=1
    summary[kind+"_genes"]+=len(members)
    for i in members:
        assert i not in owners
        owners[i]=(ordinal,kind)
graph_readback_path=repo/"benchmark_tools/results/deferred_graph_context_independent_readback_20261013.json"
graph_readback=json.loads(graph_readback_path.read_text())
assert graph_readback["status"]=="all_paired_baseline_graph_context_strata_independently_recounted"
context=json.loads(Path(graph_readback["report"]["path"]).read_text())
pair_readback_path=repo/"benchmark_tools/results/deferred_pair_localization_independent_readback_20261013.json"
pair_readback=json.loads(pair_readback_path.read_text())
paired=json.loads(Path(pair_readback["checked"][0]["path"]).read_text())
old_graph_readback_path=repo/"benchmark_tools/results/qfo_graph_stage_readback_20261013.json"
old_graph_readback=json.loads(old_graph_readback_path.read_text())
old_graph=json.loads(Path(old_graph_readback["checked"][0]["path"]).read_text())
checked.extend([record(graph_readback_path),graph_readback["report"],record(pair_readback_path),pair_readback["checked"][0],record(old_graph_readback_path),old_graph_readback["checked"][0]])
tables=[]
for item in [paired["arms"][0]["table"],paired["arms"][1]["table"],old_graph["table"]]:
    checked.append(item)
    with Path(item["path"]).open() as stream:
        tables.append(list(csv.DictReader(stream,delimiter="\t")))
assert all(len(t)==23934 for t in tables)
groups={}
for a,b,g in zip(*tables):
    assert all(g[k]==a[k] for k in a)
    assert all(a[k]==b[k] for k in ("left","right","reference_label","native_gene_left","native_gene_right","reference_is_cross_species","initial_hit_directions","forward_normalized_score","reverse_normalized_score"))
    ia,ib=(index[a[k]] for k in ("native_gene_left","native_gene_right"))
    oa,ob=owners.get(ia),owners.get(ib)
    if oa is not None and ob is not None and oa[0]==ob[0]:
        kind=oa[1]
        assert g["same_profile_expanded"]=="True"
    elif oa is not None and ob is not None:
        kind="different_eligible_families"
        assert g["same_profile_expanded"]=="False"
    elif oa is not None or ob is not None:
        kind="one_eligible_family"
        assert g["same_profile_expanded"]=="False"
    else:
        kind="no_eligible_family"
    for key in ("transition:"+a["category"]+"->"+b["category"],"variant:"+b["category"]+"/"+b["stage"]):
        bucket=groups.setdefault(key,{"pairs":0,"eligibility":Counter(),"same_profile_expanded_by_eligibility":Counter()})
        bucket["pairs"]+=1
        bucket["eligibility"][kind]+=1
        bucket["same_profile_expanded_by_eligibility"][kind+"/same_"+g["same_profile_expanded"]]+=1
assert {k:v["pairs"] for k,v in groups.items()}==graph_readback["strata_counts"]
assert sum(v["pairs"] for k,v in groups.items() if k.startswith("transition:"))==23934
for module in (refinement,sys.modules["benchmark_tools.audit_historical_profile_ablation"],sys.modules["benchmark_tools.prepare_ob_candidate_neighborhood"],sys.modules["benchmark_tools.run_membership_hillclimb"]):
    checked.append(record(Path(module.__file__)))
for item in checked:
    check(item)
memory=dict(line.split(":",1) for line in Path("/proc/self/status").read_text().splitlines() if ":" in line)
peak=int(memory["VmHWM"].split()[0])
assert peak<=2*1024**2 and time.monotonic()-started<=600
write_json(output,{"status":"complete_all_reference_executed_copy_eligibility_join_verified","source_revision":plan["source_revision"],"checked":checked,"eligible_family_summary":dict(summary),"strata":groups,"fixed_component_threshold":refinement.DEFAULT_PANEL_COPY_COMPONENT_MIN_EDGE_WEIGHT,"fixed_deferral_bound":500,"resources":{"wall_s":time.monotonic()-started,"linux_post_exec_peak_rss_kib":peak,"rusage_maxrss_kib":resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss},"analysis_recipe":os.environ["DIAGNOSTIC_RECIPE"],"scope":"Complete-cohort descriptive join to immutable executed structural sidecars from a live branch job. Native score admission and raw graph-array audits are inherited; no new inference or variant-causal graph claim.","defaults_promoted":False,"goal_completed":False})
print(json.dumps({"summary":dict(summary),"remaining_separated":groups["variant:FN/different_candidate_families"],"rescued":groups["transition:FN->TP"]},indent=2))
scope: Complete-cohort descriptive join to immutable executed structural sidecars from a live branch job. Native score admission and raw graph-array audits are inherited; no new inference or variant-causal graph claim.
